label: UK 2027/28 illustrative
notes: Illustrative rate pack. Used for year 2 onwards of a Ltd Co Calculator run, and for later years until a newer pack is published.
Property income: separate rates of 22% / 42% / 47% from 6 April 2027 (England, Wales and Northern Ireland), taxed after other non-savings income and before savings and dividends.
Section 24 finance cost relief at the property basic rate (22%).
Savings income: 22% / 42% / 47% from 6 April 2027. Dividend rates unchanged from 2026/27 (10.75% / 35.75% / 39.35%).
Personal allowance is used against employment, trading and pension income before property, savings and dividends.
Personal allowance and band thresholds frozen until April 2031. Corporation tax and SDLT unchanged from 2026/27.
Source: HMRC, Change to tax rates for property, savings and dividend income (technical note, Budget 2025).
Capital gains: £3,000 annual exempt amount; 18% within the basic rate band, 24% above.
Not HMRC-authoritative. Not tax, legal or financial advice.
